We just adopted a kitten who's litter was dumped out in the cold. We live in freaking Alaska! Luckily the litter was found by the shelter. But two ran off. One was taken in, and while my soon to be mother in law was put walking with her 4H group, a lone kitten came out of the bushes mewing. She brought the little guy back to her pet supply/boarding place and got him all fed and warm. We met him at the shop and he turned on the charm. Walked right up to my fiancé and I and started purring up a storm and jumping up to be held. Then he scratched the scratching post and used the litterbox. We'd hold him and he'd rub and rumble and purr and even let us rub his tum.

He's now about 9-10 weeks old, and just got his first round of shots on Saturday. We named him Toby. He's a great little buddy.
